Team — heads up: CobaltBridge (CB-2026-142) is asking for a baseline of 40 dedicated GPUs with burst to 90 for the first 14 days of their Nov 24 go-live. They are willing to sign a 3-month minimum. This conflicts with a scheduled onboarding for NimbusAI (pre-committed reserve) in the same US pool for late Nov that we have limited headroom on.

Summary of constraints:
- CB: 40 guaranteed, 90 burst for 14 days (requested start Nov 22 warm-up).
- NimbusAI: Reserved tranche of 60 GPUs for Q4 ramp (signed, but with flexible start +/- 2 weeks).
- Current spare capacity in us-west infer cluster for Nov 22–Dec 5: ~70 GPUs if we keep some headroom for infra ops (maintenance & redundancy).

Options I see (tradeoffs below):

Option A — Honor CB pre-commit fully (40 guaranteed) + conditional burst up to 90 via transient slots:
  - Impact: Nimbus may need to push start by 2 weeks or accept reduced immediate throughput.
  - Financial: CB upsell to 3-month commit should cover opportunity cost; requires Sales legal signoff for temporary tranche.

Option B — Offer CB 40 guaranteed + capped burst to 60 (soft cap), with auto-fallback to a slightly larger model sharding to meet p50:
  - Impact: preserves room for Nimbus onboarding and protects other reserved customers.
  - Financial: smaller incremental ARR; may risk CB churn if burst insufficient.

Option C — Hybrid: 30 guaranteed + 60 burst guaranteed for first 7 days, then back to 30 baseline; provide CB a discount if they accept staged ramp.

Questions for ops/leadership:
- Marissa: do we prioritize signed deals with immediate go-live risk (CB has high revenue and strategic visibility) over Nimbus (longer-term but already signed)?
- Ben: can ops provision an ephemeral burst pool across regions (us-east + us-west) to aggregate 90 GPUs for short windows without impacting Nimbus? What are preemption semantics?
- Vivek: any infra constraints for cross-region burst routing for low-latency p50 targets?
- Lauren: what pricing concessions are reasonable to make this allocation palatable while protecting revenue?

I propose a quick triage call at 10:30 PT to lock a decision so we can update CB by EOD. Marking urgent.

Thanks — Priyom
